guide.overview: [CONTENT NEEDED] Explain Focus & Flow as a daily companion for deliberate, focused work.
guide.what_you_do: [CONTENT NEEDED] Describe daily sessions, Focus Reset, Thinking Partner, and habit building.
guide.what_you_produce: [CONTENT NEEDED] List: session journal, weekly patterns, focus insights.
guide.save_resume_behavior: Each session saves automatically. You can do short sessions anytime. Your Focus Reset and journal entries are preserved across all sessions.
guide.privacy_statement: All session data stays in your browser. No data is sent to servers or used externally. Your focus patterns are for your eyes only.
guide.reset_behavior: You can reset Focus & Flow and start fresh. Resetting clears all session history. If you've exported your session record, that file is saved separately.
guide.product_boundaries: Focus & Flow is an educational practice tool. It does not diagnose attention conditions, treat ADHD, or replace medical consultation.
guide.accessibility_statement: Focus & Flow supports High Contrast, Readable Font, Text Scale, and Reduced Motion. Animations can be disabled.

launcher.role_description: A daily companion for focused work and deliberate thinking.
